entities.summary: Marks and Spencer plc is a major British multinational retailer based in London, England, that specialises in selling clothing, beauty products, home products and food products. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index. Marks & Spencer is a website in Northern Europe, established around 1884. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
